hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 constant-price curve between ETH and phiEth (a wrapped ETH token). In beforeSwap, it takes the full input from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, and settles the output — fully bypassing concentrated liquidity. Liquidity addition is blocked via beforeAddLiquidity revert.
